texture_px.basis: NORTH_STAR.md:50 (2K); docs/design/ASSET_PIPELINE.md:38 (2048 squared for heroes); one set per species serves every team through the paint mask

resident_texture_memory_mib.basis: Computed, not measured. Godot: a VRAM-compressed 2K set = BC3 baseColor+mask (4 MiB) + BC1 ORM (2 MiB) + RGTC normal (4 MiB), x 4/3 for mips = 13.3 MiB (formats per the Godot 4.7 image import docs); per species 2 sets + the shared 1K rifle set (3.3 MiB) = 30; cast 4 x 13.3 + 3.3 = 57. Twin: the existing WebP path (tools/assets/make-web-variant.mjs:31-32) decodes to RGBA8: a 1K set = 3 x 1024^2 x 4 B x 4/3 = 16 MiB; cast 5 sets = 80. KTX2 is not built (no encoder in make-web-variant, no KTX2Loader in src/client): a lead card (CHAR-KTX2) could lower the twin figure. 2K WebP (64 MiB per set) is rejected.

web_variant_bytes.basis: Kit pieces are capped at 600 KB (ASSET_PIPELINE.md:46). MASTER_PLAN.md:304 caps the initial download at 5 MB gzipped: character textures load after match start, or the owner supersedes that budget.

simultaneous_character_test_counts.basis: 1v1 and 2v2 are the product; 8 = a 4v4 stress; 24 = MASTER_PLAN.md:302 (fully animated characters on screen)

incremental_p95_frame_time_budget_ms.basis: The standard's measure: the increment of a candidate over a live PLACEHOLDER baseline, same session, scene, camera path, resolution and hardware (production-standard.md §8). MASTER_PLAN.md:299 gives characters 1.5 ms GPU as a share of the frame, which is a different measure. Measurable only on a real GPU by a human (AAA_PLAN.md:62).

target_hardware.basis: 'the reference desktop' (docs/design/AAA_PLAN.md:62) has no recorded specification

target_resolution.basis: the Godot base viewport (engines/godot/project.godot:15-16) and the 30 m check's render size; LOD switches are also checked at 1440p

Spine flex at Plant and in turns: overlapping vest plates keep covering the body (no gap visible at V3)

Tail: six weighted bones holding the S-curve; spring motion bounded so the tail never drops below the head in Idle, Walk or Plant (the species cue holds in motion)

delivery.editable_source_rule: Scripts are the source and no .blend is committed (tools/assets/README.md, Sources). Manual art (sculpt, weights, keyed motion) is kept as data files the build script reads, hashed in the manifest and never regenerated over (OD-12). The Rigify control rig is regenerated by a pinned script from a hashed metarig data file; keyed control-rig actions are hashed key tables (OD-12); both regenerations are listed in the receipt's tool_versions.
delivery.production_layout: assets/masters/Char_Cat_Rifleman.glb (PNG textures; Godot imports it) + its web variant (meshopt; WebP textures at 1K or below, the existing make-web-variant path; KTX2 only after a lead card; path proposed: public/assets/chars/Char_Cat_Rifleman.glb) + an assets/manifest.json entry (docs/design/ASSET_PIPELINE.md:42-45). lod_selection.rule: One function of h with hysteresis and instant switches, written twice (GDScript and TS) as mirrored code with a Vitest parity test that parses the Godot file (the pattern of tests/unit/kit-cover.test.ts). src/shared is authority code and never reads a GLB (docs/design/ASSET_PIPELINE.md:47-48).

clip_table.rule: Loop modes, stride_length_m, stance windows and layer masks come from this one data file, read by the Godot import script and the twin loader, never from name tokens (Godot loops any clip whose name begins or ends with "loop" or "cycle" and keeps the token in the name).
